description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the application baseline to the latest supported Java/framework level for modernization readiness.
tasks.reason: The project currently targets Java 8 and needs a modern baseline before cloud-native transformations.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade project runtime/build compatibility from Java 8 to the latest supported Java baseline and align project configuration for modern framework compatibility while preserving current business behavior.

tasks.description: Modernize messaging by migrating RabbitMQ-based integration to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native messaging on Azure is required for managed reliability and operational simplification.
tasks.requirements: Migrate current RabbitMQ messaging usage to Azure Service Bus and align messaging configuration to Azure-native connectivity and authentication patterns.

tasks.description: Modernize Azure SQL connectivity by moving from password-based access to managed identity patterns.
tasks.reason: Cloud-native security requires removing static credentials and adopting managed identity.
tasks.requirements: Modernize SQL connectivity for Azure SQL Database using managed identity based authentication and remove dependency on hardcoded or secret-based database credentials.

tasks.description: Scan dependencies for known CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security validation and CVE remediation are mandatory in the modernization workflow.
tasks.requirements: Scan all project dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities to minimum patched versions. For major-version remediation, document upgrade risk and verify build/test outcomes after fixes.

tasks.description: Deploy the modernized application to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: User requested Azure deployment with a cloud-native service target.
tasks.requirements: Containerize and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps using Azure-native deployment flow, with runtime configuration aligned to migrated Azure messaging and database services.
